description.value: John B Pub is a neighbourhood gastro pub that has been welcoming guests in Coquitlam since 1978, boasting one of BC's largest draught selections with 86 taps and the province's biggest back bar featuring over 465 spirits. The kitchen offers an upscale take on bar food with inventive monthly features, and live music runs four nights a week. It is a 19+ establishment with no children permitted.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at johnbpub.com is fully accessible and confirms a long-operating pub at 1000 Austin Avenue, Coquitlam — not North Vancouver as the OSM community tag states — with pub phone 604-931-5115. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all such fields are null per absence-of-evidence rules. The OSM record lacks address and phone, so both are sourced from the website; the website URL matches OSM.
